newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador 1997 inflation to climb to about 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador 1997 inflation to climb to about 30 pct.

text.p: Ecuador's inflation rate should climb this year to about 30 percent from 25.5 percent in 1996, Central Bank general manager Fidel Jaramillo said Monday.
"I believe that by the end of this year inflation will remain at the current level of 30 percent," he said in a television interview.
Accumulated inflation in the first two months of 1997 was about 10 percent, Jaramillo said. In light of this, "we will not be able to get to December with inflation below 30 percent."
Ecuadorean President Fabian Alarcon said Friday he expected inflation in 1998 to be between 20 and 23 percent.
Ecuador's official statistics institute was scheduled to announce February inflation data later on Monday.
